attribute.description: Attribute to list values of: `service.name`, `name` (span name), or any attribute name. Omit to list attribute names.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring the returned names or values must contain.

limit.description: Maximum number of results. Defaults to 100.

filters.description: Structured filters, translated to the provider's query language. All set filters must match.

service.description: Service name (`service.name`). Discover values with trace facets on `service.name`.

operation.description: Span (operation) name, e.g. `GET /api/orders`. Discover values with trace facets on `name`.

attributes.description: Exact-match span or resource attribute filters, e.g. `http.route` = `/orders` or `k8s.namespace.name` = `prod`.

errors_only.description: Only match spans with an error status.

trace_id.description: Fetch one whole trace by id; other filters and the query are ignored.

start.description: Start of the search window, in RFC3339 format, e.g. `2023-01-01T00:00:00Z`. Defaults to an hour ago.

end.description: End of the search window, in RFC3339 format, e.g. `2023-01-01T00:00:00Z`. Defaults to now.
